newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares set high in stable turnover.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares set high in stable turnover.

text.p: 1140 GMT - Most Polish shares fell but gains by some heavyweights pushed the main WIG index to its 33-month high. Turnover was stable and selling stronger after price fixing. * The main market's WIG index rose 34.4 points, or 0.2 percent, to 15,979.3, the WIG 20 rose 0.1 percent to 1,601.3 and the parallel market's WIRR rose 0.3 percent to 2,839.1. * Turnover stayed virtually flat at 175.6 million zlotys on both markets as 50 issues fell, 20 rose and 16 were flat. Sell offers for 10 stocks and buy orders for seven were unmatched. Most active Bank Slaski soared 9.9 percent in a 9.3-million-zloty turnover.
